steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: open-smart-start
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setCatalogOpen(false); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => (x.textContent || '').trim() === 'Arrange'); b?.click(); setTimeout(() => { const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role=menuitem]')].find((x) => (x.textContent || '').includes('Smart Start')); m?.click(); }, 300); })()
